display_name: DURA 可逆耦合 GPU 训练
description: 在冻结 DURA 输出上训练四层时间奇偶加性可逆耦合，目标源 IQ 加 DURA 波形保护。

data.representation: Paired source received/clean and frozen DURA output/physical variance

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

permissions.claim_scope: F-free and TX-label-free paired source IQ training, source IQ diagnostics; no target score

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA and newly initialized 42888-parameter, four-layer zero-head additive coupling
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: DURA source-only; source context exact ordered 32768 fit IDs and no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: DURA and fixed source IQ context have no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch five, no target or pilot-based selection

rows.method: Four trainable alternating even/odd additive invertible couplings after frozen DURA
rows.purpose: Train a reversible waveform correction using source clean IQ and DURA guard
rows.seed_notes: Correction initialization 2026110612; source fit ID selection 2026110611; training order 2026110613; evaluation 2026092701

notes: Four additive temporal coupling layers have explicit analytic inverse without input, source clean, F or hidden context; floating point recovery verified on source.
Theoretical invertibility does not imply improved identity recognition or preserve information exactly under finite precision.
Train fixed five epochs on source-only IQ and DURA guard; no F/TX/V/target reads or target selection.
Frozen model followed by mandatory 168000 x seven Phase1 ground views using Tri-SIG-TIME SSL and independent truth-last scoring.
GPU0 queue waits until fewer than three total compute apps and at least 4096 MiB are free; other owner tasks are preserved.
